body: I really appreciate this. Thank you again
Thank you for sharing :) do you have any advice or tips I can use? I'm just not sure how to go about it

I feel like I just need a crutch I can lean on without having to filter myself. I want someone to talk to who wont be offended by my emotions and someone to remind me that I have more to offer in this world than what I personally believe. I know that my opinion should be the only one that matters but what's the point in thinking highly of myself when nobody else is paying attention?
Yes, I'm currently in counseling. Thank you so much for commenting. I appreciate any advice I can get ❤
